no_project: Open a project to see its product.
title: Product
info_what: The product this project ships: its infrastructure, its backend (the gears) and, if it has one, its frontend. Configure it in the parts below, save it to product.gdl — a revision Studio keeps — then build and deploy what was saved, in Releases.
info_verdict: The verdict is the Gearbox engine's at the last check. Published: the description is in the repository too.
read_failed: The product could not be read: {error}
action_take_from_code: Take the product from the code
sources_none: revision {revision} pins none — save again to pin them
roles_hint: Gears: "Create a gear" puts new gears in this source. Publish: a published product.gdl goes to this source; with none marked, Studio keeps the revisions only. Neither decides what a build clones.
roles_gears_title: "Create a gear" puts new gears here
roles_home_title: The description travels with this source: its path(...) sources resolve here
